public.title: Sliding Window Maximum
public.description: Return the maximum in every consecutive window of exactly k values, from left to right. values contains 1 to 1000 integers between -10000 and 10000; k is between 1 and values.length.
hints: Keep candidate indices in decreasing value order.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: A monotone deque removes expired indices and values dominated by a newer element. Every index enters and leaves once. O(n) time and O(k) active space.
